workload.evidence_rule: Every candidate receives byte-identical candidate-neutral request packets built from the same prepared same-locale EvidencePack data and the same locale-native dialogue turns. Expected citations/dispositions are stored only in the scorer oracle, never in model input.

prepared_evidence_packet.answer_rule: answer cases require answer-ready local evidence, a nonempty canonical context_jsonl, the expected local citation, and zero pre-harness model invocations.
prepared_evidence_packet.terminal_rule: abstain, clarify, and refuse cases must remain terminal before model invocation; their prepared packet has zero model invocations and no model response is admitted.

rules: Only expected answer cases may have a candidate response.
citation_ids must be nonempty, unique, and a subset of the scorer's expected local citations.
answer_text may not contain thought tags; raw model output remains ignored local benchmark evidence.
output_tokens is in [1, 96], timing/resource values are nonnegative, and network_calls is zero.

human_review.claim_rule: Every answer has at least one reviewed claim. Every claim must be marked supported and cite one or more citation_ids already emitted by that response. Unsupported factual claims are a hard failure regardless of style, latency, or resource result.
human_review.locale_rule: A passing report contains one complete human-review record for every answer case in every supported locale.

measurement.selection_boundary: M6-02 records comparable measurements only. M6-03 applies the target-host resource protocol; M6-04 decides a winner.

boundaries.output: Workloads, raw candidate responses, reviews, and reports are ignored artifacts under documentation/.cache/bpm093-m6-02/.

progress.content: real contract/evidence validation and locale-local workload or score completion; no synthetic progress or ETA
